note: The vitest setup stub deliberately calls raw DOM APIs (createElement, createEl, createDocumentFragment) in order to BUILD the very Obsidian helpers the rule wants callers to use. Rewriting these to createEl/createDiv/createFragment would make the shim call itself. Assessed as a rule defect; upstream report not yet filed.

Rule wants 'Agent console'. 'Agent Console' is the product name — a proper noun — and is the string used on the store listing, the docs site and the manifest. Renaming it to satisfy sentence case would rename the product. Assessed as a rule defect; upstream report not yet filed.

rerender()'s pre-1.13 fallback is the single intentional display() caller: minAppVersion is 1.11.4, so users below 1.13 still render the imperative tab. Remove this entry when minAppVersion bumps to 1.13.0 and display() is deleted (declarative migration Path A flip) — see vault note 'Agent Console Declarative Settings Migration' D3.
